title: Quenched Syrian Peanut Butter Tagine
description: A creamy, aromatic tagine bursting with nutty peanut butter, spices, and tomato, perfect for a lazy Sunday dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a tagine or heavy skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and sauté until translucent, about 4 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and chili flakes and cook for another minute until fragrant.
Pour in the tomato paste and stir until it blends with the spices, cooking for 2 minutes.
Add the peanut butter and vegetable stock, whisking until the peanut butter is fully incorporated and the sauce becomes smooth.
Season the mixture with salt and pepper, then reduce the heat to low and let it simmer for 20 minutes to develop the flavors.
Check the consistency, adding a splash more stock if it is too thick.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro, over couscous or steamed rice if desired.
